repair.content:
Enlarge S to make traceA and d units; correct norm scalings. With r=v(z1),t=v(z2), integrality gives t-r>=0,t>=0; unit determinant gives (n+1)t-nr=0, hence r=t=0.

Restrict to K' orbit; equivariance plus K'-fixed spherical vector preserves normalization.

T integral iff L subset Ldual; xu integral iff L subset uLambda subset Ldual.
